_readme: Vehicle & RTO content pack — UNVERIFIED SCAFFOLD.
RTO processes and fees are set per state and change often. Every rule here
seeds unverified and every fee is an estimate. Confirm against the state's
Parivahan pages before publishing. See content/README.md.

documents.name: Vehicle Registration Certificate (RC)
documents.description: The RC book or smart card proving who owns the vehicle.
documents.typicalValidity: 15 years for a new private vehicle, then renewed every 5 years

documents.name: Vehicle Insurance Certificate
documents.description: Valid third-party or comprehensive motor insurance.
documents.typicalValidity: 1 year (3 or 5 years for a new vehicle's third-party cover)
documents.notes: Driving without valid third-party cover is an offence, so this is checked at almost every RTO counter.

documents.name: PUC Certificate
documents.description: Pollution Under Control certificate from an authorised testing centre.
documents.typicalValidity: 6 months for most vehicles; 1 year for a new one

documents.name: Form 29 & 30 (Transfer of Ownership)
documents.description: The RTO's sale forms — Form 29 is the notice of transfer, Form 30 the report.
documents.notes: Both must be signed by the seller and the buyer. Form 29 is usually needed in duplicate, or triplicate for an inter-state sale.

documents.name: Vehicle NOC
documents.description: No Objection Certificate from the RTO where the vehicle is registered, needed before re-registering it in another state.

documents.name: Vehicle Sale Invoice
documents.description: The dealer's invoice for a new vehicle, or the sale agreement for a used one.

documents.name: Chassis Pencil Print
documents.description: A pencil rubbing of the chassis number, taken from the vehicle itself.
documents.notes: Taken at the RTO in most states, but some ask you to bring it. Cheap to prepare and expensive to be missing.

documents.name: Counterparty ID & Address Proof
documents.description: A copy of the other side's photo ID and address proof — the buyer's, or the seller's, depending on which side of the deal you are on.
documents.notes: A separate registry entry from your own ID on purpose: a rule listing "Aadhaar" for both sides would union into one row and lose the distinction.

documents.name: Road Tax Receipt
documents.description: Proof that road tax has been paid in the state of registration.
documents.notes: Re-registering in a new state usually means paying its road tax and claiming a refund of the unused portion from the old one.
